summary: Iteration 13: Tested MongoDB persistence and Stats & History dashboard features. All 21 backend tests PASS. All frontend tests PASS. MongoDB persistence for tables (create/join/leave/delete) verified directly via motor async client. Stats (/api/stats) and History (/api/history) endpoints verified with mock hand data injected into MongoDB. History page UI tested with Playwright: Stats button, /history route, both tabs (Leaderboard & Recent Hands), empty states, leaderboard rows, hand rows, and expand functionality all verified.

minor.issue: Dead/redundant code: `room.hand.contributions[uid] = room.hand.contributions.get(uid, 0)` is immediately overwritten by the next line `room.hand.contributions[uid] = p.bet_total`. First line is unnecessary but harmless.
game_tables collection has no index created on startup. Only hand_history has indexes. For production scale this could cause slow lookups, but acceptable for current app scale.

integration_issues.issue: Console error 'WebSocket is closed before the connection is established' appears in browser console. This is benign - happens during test session lifecycle when browser navigates away before WS fully connects. Not visible to users.

critical_code_review_comments: Minor: Dead code in _apply_action (line 560): `room.hand.contributions[uid] = room.hand.contributions.get(uid, 0)` is immediately overwritten and can be removed.
Minor: game_tables collection lacks an index on startup. Consider adding `await db.game_tables.create_index('updated_at')` in startup() for future scalability.
Note: `python-dotenv could not parse statement starting at line 3` in backend logs - harmless warning about JWT_SECRET format in .env, does not affect functionality.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all features verified: Stats button, /history route, leaderboard, recent hands, empty states, expand)

seed_data_creation: 2 mock hand history documents inserted to MongoDB (UI_TEST_TABLE) for UI testing, then deleted. Backend tests used TEST_MongoTable_13 and TEST_PersistCheck_13 which were cleaned up. TEST_AdminCheck_13 created and cleaned up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: MongoDB persistence is working. Web app at /app/web/src/ (NOT /app/frontend/ which is a separate Expo project). Backend at /app/backend/server.py. The game_tables collection stores tables with string _id (the 6-char table_id). hand_history collection stores completed hands. Stats endpoint aggregates hands and returns sorted list by chips_net desc. All data-testids present and working. For UI testing: login uses custom PIN keypad (data-testid='profile-{username}' and 'pin-btn-{n}'), auto-submits on 4 digits.

rca_of_tests.table_persistence: game_rooms in-memory dict is synced with MongoDB via _save_table() (upsert) called after create/join/leave/kick. On startup, _restore_tables() reloads all tables from game_tables collection into game_rooms dict.
rca_of_tests.hand_history: _save_hand_history() called from _finalize_showdown and _end_hand_last_player. Stores full hand record with board results, player P&L, and pot details. Stats endpoint aggregates this data on-demand.
rca_of_tests.leave_table_behavior: When last player leaves, table is deleted from both game_rooms dict and MongoDB game_tables collection (not an error, correct behavior).
